recent_extension.warning: No values extended beyond each frozen source; 2026 partial years are separate.

NDVI_support.meaning: spatial median of per-pixel temporal medians; not daily mean or forage yield

units.shortwave: MJ/m2/day, daily mean within calendar month/season
units.DTR: degC, daily Tmax minus daily Tmin averaged
units.precipitation: mm, sum of complete UTC days
units.lake: ha, quality-qualified detected area in fixed KMZ, not volume or level
units.local_runoff: 10000 m3 per administrative area per year, not measured inflow to lake

statistical_intervals: Year-cluster CR1 t(G-1) exploratory 95% intervals; calendar-year HAC lag2 also retained. These are marginal unadjusted intervals, not simultaneous confirmation. Multiple screens are descriptive, without selected significance claims.
correlation_type: All raw_r and partial_r in this analysis are Pearson; partial_r correlates residuals from the identical listed control matrix. Do not confuse with older Spearman tables.

field_semantics.temperature_max_C_at_month_or_season: Mean of daily maximum air temperature, NOT period maximum.
field_semantics.temperature_min_C_at_month_or_season: Mean of daily minimum air temperature, NOT period minimum.
field_semantics.SWE_daily_max_mm_at_month_or_season: Mean of each day maximum SWE, NOT period maximum.
field_semantics.SWE_peak_DJF_mm: Maximum snow water equivalent in prior December/current January-February window.
field_semantics.lake_observed_months_mean_NOT_annual_are: Mean over available qualified Jun-Sep months only; variable month composition, NOT annual lake area.

persistence_quality_note: The 32 exact prior-month pairs include 6 June outcomes with May prior lake observations; May is a transition/possible ice season. A separate post-review addendum repeats the same-sample comparison for 26 entirely warm-season pairs.

POWER_source_change_warning.solar_source_table: SRB 4.0-IP: 1984-01-01 through 2000-12-31; CERES SYN1deg Edition4.2: 2001-01-01 onward, apart from near-real-time FLASHFlux. These are official-era labels, not per-day provider flags supplied in the frozen response.
POWER_source_change_warning.analysis_limit: NASA warns against assessing climate trends across an energy-flux source change. This package does not interpret 1985-onward shortwave trends as homogeneous single-source climate trends; the core 59-month sample has one 2000 observation.
